intro: The path opens into a quiet clearing.$A Medicham sits perfectly still atop a flat stone, deep in meditation. The air around it feels… heavier.
title: Passivity is a Prize
description: The Medicham radiates focus. It does not react to your presence at all — yet you feel an invitation. Perhaps if one of your Pokémon could match its stillness, it might reach something dormant within itself.

1.label: Join the Meditation
1.tooltip:
(+) Awaken a Pokémon's Passive Ability for this run
(-) It falls into a deep sleep
1.selected: Your Pokémon settles across from the Medicham and closes its eyes…$Minutes pass. Hours? The world grows very, very still.

2.label: Leave Quietly
2.selected: You tiptoe past the meditating pair.$The Medicham never stirs.

invalidSelection: This Pokémon's passive ability is already awakened.
meditationComplete: {{pokemonName}} has awakened its dormant power — {{passiveName}}!$…But it's fallen fast asleep.
outro:
When you look back, the flat stone is empty.
The stillness lingers a moment longer, then lifts.
